search.description: This plugin allows you to receive your chat messages via Discord.
search.name: Discord Chat Bridge
search.punchline: Receive your chat messages via Discord.
search.website_text:
Relays your chat from inside FFXIV to one or more Discord channels of your choosing.

You can set the same chat messages to go to multiple channels.

Does not relay chat from Discord to FFXIV. (There are several issues with this, as Discord allows a lot of features that would not map to chat in FFXIV)

Setup guide: https://github.com/reiichi001/Dalamud.DiscordBridge/wiki/Setup-Guide

variant.changelog:
Removed bot stop/start on logout/login events. It seems this was causing some issues.

The plugin will also now cache LocalPlayer on every Framework ticket instead of only on Login events. That should help with LocalPlayer resolutions showing up as null when they shouldn't be.
